papers.title: User Embeddings are Superpositions of Interpretable Behavioral Modes
papers.translated_title: 用户嵌入是可解释行为模式的叠加
papers.author: Jonathan Kozaczuk
papers.summary: User embeddings are central components of modern recommendation, personalization, and behavioral modeling systems. Though these embeddings can compactly encode rich behavioral information, they are inherently dense and opaque, limiting interpretability. To address this gap, we argue that user embeddings can be understood as sparse superpositions of interpretable behavioral modes. This structure is directly predicted by generative models of user behavior for linear embeddings and extends approximately to deep-learning representations by the superposition hypothesis. Superimposed modes can naturally be recovered by sparse dictionary learning methods, such as sparse autoencoders (SAEs), and recovered modes can be automatically named and queried in natural language. We validate mode recovery against known ground truth on synthetic data, where SAEs recover modes better than classical sparse baselines, including on transformer-encoded embeddings. We then apply the method to classical and transformer-based user embeddings from two real-world datasets. We also show how the corresponding natural-language labels enable zero-shot audience retrieval and characterization over embeddings never trained on text. The framework is post-hoc and model-agnostic, requiring no modification to the upstream embedding system.
papers.translated_summary: 用户嵌入是现代推荐、个性化和行为建模系统的核心组件。尽管这些嵌入能够紧凑地编码丰富的行为信息，但它们本质上是稠密且不透明的，限制了可解释性。为弥补这一不足，我们认为用户嵌入可以被理解为可解释行为模式的稀疏叠加。这一结构在线性嵌入下可由用户行为的生成模型直接预测，并通过叠加假设近似推广到深度学习表示。叠加的模式可以通过稀疏字典学习方法自然恢复，例如稀疏自编码器（SAEs），且恢复的模式可以自动命名并用自然语言查询。我们在合成数据上以已知的真实基准验证了模式恢复，其中SAEs在恢复模式方面优于经典稀疏基线，包括在Transformer编码的嵌入上。随后我们将该方法应用于来自两个真实世界数据集的经典和基于Transformer的用户嵌入。我们还展示了相应的自然语言标签如何支持对从未在文本上训练过的嵌入进行零样本受众检索和刻画。该框架是事后且模型无关的，无需修改上游嵌入系统。

papers.title: Do You Miss the Nights We Spent Crafting Figures? Rethinking Teaser and Framework Figures in the Age of Generative AI
papers.translated_title: 你是否怀念我们制作图形的那些夜晚？生成式AI时代对预告图与框架图的再思考
papers.author: Xiaoqi Zhao
papers.summary: Scientific figures give research ideas a visual form through choices of abstraction, composition, and emphasis. Generative AI offers new ways to realize these choices, raising questions about explanatory clarity and purposeful visual expression. We examine these questions through a visual retrospective of 371 motivation and framework figures from 200 papers. The corpus comprises a quota-based main sample of 160 papers spanning four temporal periods and a separate purposive style-contrast sample of 40 papers. A single multimodal judge evaluates six dimensions of communication and design, with three repeated judgments per figure. We attempt source-constrained revisions of all 371 figures, of which 369 pass the recorded fidelity checks. Original-figure ratings show no uniform decline across periods. Revisions increase mean clarity ratings by 0.428 points and decrease aesthetic coherence ratings by 0.111 points on a five-point scale. Gains in the six-dimension average are larger for main-sample motivation figures than for frameworks. Case analyses show that added explanation can clarify comparisons while leaving typographic hierarchy and visual economy unresolved. These model-based findings support researcher-led design, with AI assisting exploration and authors retaining responsibility for explanatory purpose, composition, and scientific relationships. The accompanying atlas and evaluation records are available at https://ntu-ai4x.github.io/Rethinking_Figures/index_en.html.
papers.translated_summary: 科学图表通过抽象、构图和强调的选择，将研究思想赋予视觉形式。生成式AI为实现这些选择提供了新途径，同时也引发了关于解释清晰度和有目的的视觉表达的问题。我们通过对来自200篇论文的371幅动机图和框架图进行视觉回顾来考察这些问题。该语料库包括一个基于配额的主样本，涵盖四个时间段共160篇论文，以及一个单独的立意性风格对比样本共40篇论文。一个多模态评判器评估传播与设计的六个维度，每幅图重复评判三次。我们尝试对所有371幅图进行源约束修订，其中369幅通过了记录的保真度检查。原始图评分在各时间段之间未显示出一致的下降。修订使平均清晰度评分提高了0.428分，使美学连贯性评分降低了0.111分（五分制）。六个维度平均值的提升在主样本的动机图中大于框架图。案例分析表明，增加解释可以阐明比较，但排版层次和视觉经济性仍未得到解决。这些基于模型的发现支持研究者主导的设计，AI辅助探索，作者保留对解释目的、构图和科学关系的责任。随附的图谱和评估记录可在 https://ntu-ai4x.github.io/Rethinking_Figures/index_en.html 获取。

papers.title: Where and Why is Grounded Reasoning Useful?
papers.translated_title: 基于推理的推理在何处以及为何有用？
papers.author: David Yan
papers.summary: Grounded reasoning, where a model outputs text coordinates of relevant locations in chain-of-thought reasoning, is a common strategy for solving complex visual reasoning problems. However, the benefits and limitations of grounded reasoning are understudied. We study where and why grounded reasoning is most useful. To do so, we introduce a chain-of-thought analysis method to measure how much a model uses its outputted grounding in its thinking trace and perform a detailed ablation study of a grounded reasoning training recipe. We find that grounded reasoning improves counting but shows no significant gain over baselines without coordinate grounding across a wide range of spatial reasoning and perception benchmarks. Using several synthetic tasks, we show that grounded reasoning is most useful when a task requires undescribable references, which are visual concepts that are difficult to describe in language. However, we observe that many existing visual reasoning benchmarks are solvable with only describable text references. To close this gap, we introduce BrickVision, a new benchmark that requires undescribable visual references to solve.
papers.translated_summary: 基于落地的推理，即模型在思维链推理中输出相关位置的文本坐标，是解决复杂视觉推理问题的一种常见策略。然而，落地推理的优势与局限性尚未得到充分研究。我们研究落地推理在何处以及为何最为有用。为此，我们引入一种思维链分析方法，以衡量模型在其思维轨迹中对其输出的落地信息的使用程度，并对一种落地推理训练方案进行详细的消融研究。我们发现，落地推理改善了计数能力，但在广泛的空间推理和感知基准上，与没有坐标落地的基线相比并未显示出显著增益。通过若干合成任务，我们表明落地推理在任务需要不可描述指代时最为有用，不可描述指代是难以用语言描述的视觉概念。然而，我们观察到许多现有的视觉推理基准仅凭可描述的文本指代即可解决。为弥补这一差距，我们引入了 BrickVision，一个需要不可描述视觉指代才能解决的新基准。

papers.title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
papers.translated_title: SwarmEvolve：用于进化发现与优化的潜在智能体集群
papers.author: Qile Jiang
papers.summary: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. However, the process is often slow because the LLM generates a long textual chain of thought for each round and must repeat this generation many times to maintain population diversity. We present SwarmEvolve, a framework in which hundreds of low-cost agents per round work in swarms, reason in latent space without decoding to text, and share information by passing KV caches. Each swarm studies the problem from a different angle. A novelty filter keeps the most distinct agent ideas by directly measuring the distances between the agents' hidden state vectors. Crossover of ideas happens naturally in latent space, as a summarizer agent receives the combined KV caches of all swarm members. On 21 problems in mathematical discovery and scientific computing, SwarmEvolve gets the highest average score and needs a median of only 3 to 8 minutes to reach the best scores that other state-of-the-art frameworks reach in 60 minutes. On several problems, SwarmEvolve with Qwen3 8B improves on the solutions that AlphaEvolve first found with frontier LLMs. Our work shows that agent swarms that communicate in latent space offer a fast, low-cost approach to program search for scientific problems.
papers.translated_summary: LLM引导的进化搜索利用AI智能体，通过迭代优化解并组合高分方法来改进数学与计算问题的程序。然而，该过程往往较慢，因为LLM在每一轮都会生成冗长的文本思维链，并且必须多次重复这一生成过程以维持种群多样性。我们提出SwarmEvolve，这是一个框架，其中每轮有数百个低成本智能体以群体方式协同工作，在潜在空间中进行推理而无需解码为文本，并通过传递KV缓存来共享信息。每个群体从不同角度研究问题。新颖性过滤器通过直接测量智能体隐藏状态向量之间的距离，保留最具差异性的智能体想法。想法的交叉在潜在空间中自然发生，因为一个总结器智能体接收所有群体成员组合后的KV缓存。在数学发现和科学计算中的21个问题上，SwarmEvolve获得了最高的平均分数，并且仅需中位数3到8分钟即可达到其他最先进框架在60分钟内达到的最佳分数。在若干问题上，使用Qwen3 8B的SwarmEvolve改进了AlphaEvolve最初用前沿LLM找到的解。我们的工作表明，在潜在空间中通信的智能体群体为科学问题的程序搜索提供了一种快速、低成本的方法。

papers.title: Scientist World: Grow a Research World for AI-Scientists
papers.translated_title: 科学家世界：为AI科学家培育一个研究世界
papers.author: Taiming Lu
papers.summary: AI-Scientists arrived, but a world for them to grow in did not. Human scientists take theirs for granted $-$ centuries of open problems and shared ideas, waiting in the scientific literature. To AI-Scientists, that world is readable but not runnable, so we build Scientist World for them: every research paper becomes an executable environment. Our autonomous pipeline extracts each paper's open-ended research question and reproduces its proposed method as the baseline; an AI-Scientist entering the environment is evaluated against what the human authors achieved. We release the first 1,000 verified environments. With the world as an evaluation, we found that frontier AI-Scientists can already surpass the human researchers 74% of the time. As a record of how AI does science, it contains 6,400 hours of research traces, with every idea, experiment, failure, and success. As a training ground, we are able to raise (+158%) a small model to match frontier models in research ideation. At last, AI-Scientists' own world has arrived, grown from and growing with science itself.
papers.translated_summary: AI-Scientists已经到来，但一个供它们成长的世界尚未形成。人类科学家对此习以为常——几个世纪以来的开放问题与共享思想，静静存在于科学文献之中。对AI-Scientists而言，那个世界可读却不可运行，因此我们为它们构建了Scientist World：每一篇研究论文都成为一个可执行环境。我们的自主流水线提取每篇论文的开放式研究问题，并将其提出的方法复现为基线；进入环境的AI-Scientist将对照人类作者所取得的成果接受评估。我们发布了首批1,000个经过验证的环境。以这个世界作为评估基准，我们发现前沿AI-Scientists已经能够在74%的情况下超越人类研究者。作为AI如何从事科学研究的记录，它包含6,400小时的研究轨迹，涵盖每一个想法、实验、失败与成功。作为训练场，我们能够将一个小型模型提升（+158%），使其在研究构思方面媲美前沿模型。最终，AI-Scientists自己的世界已经到来，它从科学本身中生长出来，并与科学共同成长。

papers.title: EgoGeneralist: Unifying Egocentric Action-Video Tasks through Video-Native Modeling
papers.translated_title: EgoGeneralist：通过视频原生建模统一自我中心动作视频任务
papers.author: Yanlin Jin
papers.summary: Modern video models possess strong visual priors, yet do not natively represent human action in metric 3D space. We present EgoGeneralist, which adapts pretrained video generators to unify action-conditioned egocentric video generation, pose estimation, and joint action-video generation. Our role-adaptive action renderer provides video-native representations for multidirectional action-video learning, making metric motion usable as both a spatial control signal and a recoverable generation target. Cross-stream action-video coupling establishes close correspondence between metric motion and visual dynamics through lightweight adaptation while preserving the pretrained visual prior. Together, these designs establish a generalist framework spanning five action-video tasks. Despite adaptation only on controlled laboratory recordings, EgoGeneralist generalizes to diverse unseen scenes and interactions with effective action control and visual quality, bridging pretrained visual knowledge and metric 3D human motion.
papers.translated_summary: 现代视频模型具备强大的视觉先验，但并不能原生地在度量三维空间中表示人类动作。我们提出EgoGeneralist，它将预训练视频生成器加以适配，以统一动作条件的第一人称视频生成、姿态估计以及联合动作-视频生成。我们的角色自适应动作渲染器为多方向动作-视频学习提供视频原生表示，使度量运动既可作为空间控制信号，又可作为可恢复的生成目标。跨流动作-视频耦合通过轻量适配在度量运动与视觉动态之间建立紧密对应，同时保留预训练的视觉先验。这些设计共同构建了一个涵盖五项动作-视频任务的通用框架。尽管仅在受控实验室记录上进行适配，EgoGeneralist仍能泛化到多样未见场景与交互，并具备有效的动作控制与视觉质量，弥合了预训练视觉知识与度量三维人体运动之间的差距。

papers.title: XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration
papers.translated_title: XStack：机器学习代码库迁移的基准测试
papers.author: Linrong Cai
papers.summary: ML code should run where researchers choose, not where it was first written. Today, machine learning code mainly lives in two ecosystems, PyTorch on NVIDIA GPUs and JAX on Google TPUs. Migrating repositories between them means building and testing across frameworks and hardware. This migration is (1) a practical need, since it unlocks different hardware for researchers, and (2) a natural benchmark: it involves different frameworks and hardware, covers whole repositories, and is long-horizon and challenging. We introduce XStack, a benchmark that evaluates agents on migrating ML repositories between these two ecosystems. Each agent receives a PyTorch repository and a clean TPU machine and must deliver a JAX repository. Its output passes if it meets our grading criteria, based on the source repository's published result, authenticated and calibrated by us. Migration by agents remains unreliable: Claude Opus 5 passes 75%, GPT-5.6-sol 45%, and every other agent at most 40%. XStack is a step toward freeing ML code from its ecosystem. We release XStack to make progress toward reliable migration across frameworks and hardware measurable.
papers.translated_summary: 机器学习代码应当在研究者选择的环境中运行，而不是在它最初被编写的地方运行。如今，机器学习代码主要存在于两个生态系统中：NVIDIA GPU 上的 PyTorch 和 Google TPU 上的 JAX。在这些生态系统之间迁移代码仓库，意味着要跨框架和硬件进行构建与测试。这种迁移（1）是一种实际需求，因为它为研究者解锁了不同的硬件；（2）是一个天然的基准：它涉及不同的框架和硬件，覆盖整个代码仓库，并且是长周期且具有挑战性的。我们推出 XStack，一个评估智能体在这两个生态系统之间迁移机器学习代码仓库的基准。每个智能体接收一个 PyTorch 代码仓库和一台干净的 TPU 机器，并且必须交付一个 JAX 代码仓库。如果其输出满足我们的评分标准，则视为通过，该标准基于源仓库已发表的结果，并由我们进行认证和校准。智能体进行的迁移仍然不可靠：Claude Opus 5 通过率为 75%，GPT-5.6-sol 为 45%，其他所有智能体至多为 40%。XStack 是朝着将机器学习代码从其生态系统中解放出来迈出的一步。我们发布 XStack，以使跨框架和硬件的可靠迁移进展可被衡量。

papers.title: Same Behavior, Different Mechanism: What Finite Experiments Can Certify About Integrated Information
papers.translated_title: 相同行为，不同机制：有限实验能就整合信息证明什么
papers.author: Linqian Wu
papers.summary: Interpretability, AI auditing and assessments of machine consciousness increasingly rest on mechanism-level quantities: functionals of a system's causal transition law that describe how it computes, not what it outputs. Experiments see that law only through finite, partial and noisy interventions. We ask when such a quantity is identifiable from an experiment's access, continuous in the mechanism and certifiable from finite data, and answer exactly for a deliberately demanding case - the integrated information $\varphi$ of integrated information theory - in stochastic networks of four and five units with known ground truth. Behavior can be silent: a recurrent and a feed-forward network with identical input-output laws at their response delay carry 0.28 and 0 bits, yet internal recordings separate them within 4-53 trials. Partial access can be just as blind: in our examples, units left out of a one-step recording impose precision floors of 0.30-1.02 bits that no sample size lowers, and in all-but-self parity networks, recordings of any length see several hidden units only through the product of their fidelities - a symmetry that one intervention broke in exact checks. The measure has sharp edges: because $\varphi$ selects a partition, and the cause and effect it specifies, by one criterion and reports another, infinitesimal changes of mechanism that cross an edge change it by 25-100% at 99% of the edges we found in random networks, and about 1% of surrogate models that fit interventional data almost perfectly misreport it by more than 20%. One-sided claims survive: the same data certify a lower bound on both sides of an edge, and we prove $\varphi>1.004$ bits throughout a 64-dimensional region of mechanisms and certify it from about $10^7$ controlled transitions with false-certificate probability at most $α$. Measurability is thus a design question with computable answers.
papers.translated_summary: 可解释性、AI审计和机器意识评估日益依赖于机制层面的量：系统因果转移律的泛函，这些泛函描述系统如何计算，而非输出什么。实验只能通过有限、部分且含噪的干预来观察该规律。我们追问：这样的量在何种条件下可从实验的访问中辨识、在机制上连续、并能从有限数据中得到认证，并针对一个刻意严苛的案例——整合信息论中的整合信息φ——在具有已知真值的四单元和五单元随机网络中给出精确回答。行为可以是沉默的：一个循环网络和一个前馈网络在其响应延迟处具有相同的输入-输出规律，却分别携带0.28比特和0比特，而内部记录在4-53次试验内即可将二者区分。部分访问同样可能盲目：在我们的例子中，被排除在单步记录之外的单元施加了0.30-1.02比特的精度下限，任何样本量都无法降低；而在全但自身奇偶网络中，任意长度的记录只能通过其保真度的乘积来观察若干隐藏单元——这一对称性在精确检验中被一次干预打破。该度量具有尖锐边缘：由于φ依据一个准则选择划分及其指定的因与果，却报告另一个准则，机制中跨越边缘的无穷小变化会使φ改变25-100%，在我们于随机网络中发现的99%的边缘处如此；约1%的替代模型几乎完美拟合干预数据，却将φ误报超过20%。单侧断言仍然成立：同一数据可认证边缘两侧的下界，我们证明在64维机制区域内φ>1.004比特，并从约10^7次受控转移中认证该结论，错误认证概率至多为α。因此，可测量性是一个具有可计算答案的设计问题。

papers.title: Towards interpreting any residual stream direction by scaling activation inversion
papers.translated_title: 走向通过缩放激活反转来解释任何残差流方向
papers.author: Celeste De Schamphelaere
papers.summary: To interpret a direction in a language model's residual stream, we can look for text that strongly activates it. But when such text is found by scanning a corpus, it is limited to what that corpus contains. We develop Maximally-Activating Example Metamodels (MAEMs), language models which map residual stream directions from a subject model to text exemplars that strongly activate those directions. Our objective is to maximise the cosine similarity of a supplied residual stream direction with the activations of the text generated by the MAEM. This label-free RL objective helps to scale MAEMs on diverse sources of residual stream directions. Empirically, we find the resultant metamodel produces informative exemplars: a Qwen3.6-27B MAEM inverts held-out activations better than corpus search or a natural-language autoencoder (NLA), beats corpus search (at 10M tokens) on a majority of held-out languages/domains, and activates 89% of held-out SAE features. It also identifies concepts behind steering vectors about as well as NLAs, recovers the payloads of LoRA backdoors more often than corpus search, and can even verbalise some model workspace inner monologue. Unlike explanations produced by other metamodels (e.g. NLAs), MAEM exemplars can be verified with a forward pass on the subject model, making the MAEM objective a grounded alternative for scaling the training of metamodels.
papers.translated_summary: 要解释语言模型残差流中的某个方向，我们可以寻找能强烈激活该方向的文本。但通过扫描语料库找到的此类文本受限于该语料库所包含的内容。我们开发了最大激活示例元模型（MAEMs），这是一种语言模型，可将主体模型的残差流方向映射到能强烈激活这些方向的文本示例。我们的目标是最大化所提供的残差流方向与 MAEM 生成文本的激活之间的余弦相似度。这种无标签的强化学习目标有助于在不同来源的残差流方向上扩展 MAEM。在实证中，我们发现所得的元模型能产生有信息量的示例：一个 Qwen3.6-27B MAEM 在反转留出激活方面优于语料库搜索或自然语言自编码器（NLA），在大多数留出语言/领域上优于语料库搜索（1000 万 token 规模），并能激活 89% 的留出 SAE 特征。它识别引导向量背后概念的能力与 NLA 大致相当，比语料库搜索更频繁地恢复 LoRA 后门的载荷，甚至能将某些模型工作区的内部独白言语化。与其他元模型（如 NLA）产生的解释不同，MAEM 示例可以通过对主体模型进行一次前向传播来验证，这使 MAEM 目标成为扩展元模型训练的一种有依据的替代方案。

papers.title: Adversarial Training with Large Step Sizes: Implicit Bias, Optimization, and Sharpness
papers.translated_title: 大步长对抗训练：隐式偏差、优化与锐度
papers.author: Yi Feng
papers.summary: Adversarial Training (AT) is an important method for improving model robustness. We study the dynamics of deterministic Gradient Descent (GD) in AT. Most existing works in this direction focus on the small or vanishing step sizes regime, where GD resembles a continuous-time flow. However, such step sizes can make training inefficient and are rarely used in practice. In this paper, we study the AT dynamics of GD with large constant step sizes. We first study GD in adversarial linear logistic regression, focusing on two aspects: where the model parameters converge (implicit bias) and how quickly the losses decrease (optimization). We then turn to neural networks training and study how the sharpness of losses evolve during AT. Our results advance the understanding of the behaviors of GD with large step sizes in AT and highlight three key differences from its behavior in Standard Training (ST): (i) the implicit bias gap between AT and ST, previously established only for small step sizes, persists for arbitrarily large constant step sizes, (ii) different from ST, there is no uniform rate of convergence for the optimization error in AT, and (iii) sharpness can exhibit two-stage dynamics that differ from the Edge-of-Stability behavior observed in ST.
papers.translated_summary: 对抗训练（AT）是提升模型鲁棒性的重要方法。我们研究了对抗训练中确定性梯度下降（GD）的动力学。该方向现有工作大多关注小步长或消失步长情形，此时梯度下降类似于连续时间流。然而，这样的步长会使训练效率低下，在实践中很少使用。本文研究大步长常数步长下梯度下降的对抗训练动力学。我们首先研究对抗线性逻辑回归中的梯度下降，聚焦两个方面：模型参数收敛到哪里（隐式偏差）以及损失下降有多快（优化）。随后我们转向神经网络训练，研究对抗训练过程中损失的锐度如何演化。我们的结果推进了对对抗训练中大步长梯度下降行为的理解，并突出了其与标准训练（ST）行为的三个关键差异：（i）对抗训练与标准训练之间的隐式偏差差距此前仅在小步长下建立，该差距在任意大的常数步长下依然存在；（ii）与标准训练不同，对抗训练中优化误差不存在一致的收敛速率；（iii）锐度可能呈现两阶段动力学，不同于标准训练中观察到的稳定性边缘行为。

papers.title: A subtype-specific gene regulatory program controls differential circuit integration of deep CA3 pyramidal neurons
papers.translated_title: 亚型特异性基因调控程序控制深层CA3锥体神经元的差异性环路整合
papers.author: Daaboul, D.
papers.summary: How closely related neuronal subtypes integrate into different circuits remains poorly understood. Deep and superficial hippocampal CA3 pyramidal neurons (PNs) differ in intrinsic firing and mossy fiber (MF) input at specialized postsynaptic structures termed thorny excrescences (TEs). Combining developmental single-nucleus multiomics with genetic targeting, morphological analysis and electrophysiology, we identify the transcription factor ST18 as a regulator of deep CA3 subtype identity. ST18 marks sparsely thorny and burst-firing neurons, and gene regulatory analyses predict that it represses a superficial-associated program involved in dendritic spine development, synaptic organization, and electrophysiological properties. Postnatal ST18 loss shifts the transcriptional and chromatin landscape of deep CA3 PNs toward a superficial-like state. These molecular changes are accompanied by increased TE elaboration approaching superficial levels, enhanced excitatory synaptic activity, and reduced burst-firing. Together, these findings identify ST18-dependent restriction of an alternative subtype program as a mechanism linking molecular identity to distinct input connectivity patterns and intrinsic firing properties during postnatal circuit maturation.
papers.translated_summary: 神经元亚型如何紧密相关地整合到不同环路中仍知之甚少。深部与浅部海马CA3锥体神经元（PNs）在内在放电特性以及被称为棘状突起（TEs）的特化突触后结构处接受苔藓纤维（MF）输入方面存在差异。结合发育期单核多组学与遗传靶向、形态学分析和电生理学，我们鉴定转录因子ST18为深部CA3亚型身份的调控因子。ST18标记棘状突起稀疏且呈爆发式放电的神经元，基因调控分析预测其抑制一个与浅部相关、参与树突棘发育、突触组织和电生理特性的程序。出生后ST18缺失使深部CA3 PNs的转录和染色质景观向浅部样状态转变。这些分子变化伴随棘状突起 elaboration 增加并接近浅部水平、兴奋性突触活动增强以及爆发式放电减少。总之，这些发现鉴定出ST18依赖性地限制一个替代亚型程序，作为出生后环路成熟过程中将分子身份与特定输入连接模式和内在放电特性联系起来的机制。

papers.title: Learning to play with spikes: characterizing, predicting, and engineering unsupervised plasticity rules for spiking reservoir computing
papers.translated_title: 学习与脉冲共舞：刻画、预测与设计脉冲储备池计算中的无监督可塑性规则
papers.author: Kania, M.
papers.summary: Spiking reservoir computing, and reservoir computing more generally, is a powerful and efficient framework for neuromorphic and biological applications, in which a fixed random reservoir drives a trained readout. Its performance depends critically on the reservoir initialization, so that enriching the reservoir with adaptive, unsupervised plasticity rules offers a natural solution to this limitation. However, it is unclear which rules work, or why, and how to find the best-suited rules for specific tasks without exhaustive and expensive search. Here, we learn how to play the Atari game Pong in a plastic spiking reservoir network. We systematically characterize a large family of local plasticity rules that were meta-learned in prior work. We then show that their performance is predictable and structured: high-scoring rules are characterized by strong differentiation between neurons encoding the ball trajectory and the background, with stable weight dynamics, and consistent readout alignment across time. These mechanistic signatures are not task-specific and transfer to a delayed-match recognition task. Rule performance can be estimated from rule parameters alone. Finally, conditioning simulation-based inference (SBI) on high scores allows us to sample directly from promising regions of the rule space, to discover rules that exceed the performance of those found in the prior distribution and reveal stable, high-performing configurations. Together, these results offer competitive performance against classical reservoir computing while providing a transparent, interpretable account of what makes a plasticity rule useful for neuromorphic hardware and biological computing.
papers.translated_summary: 脉冲储层计算，以及更一般意义上的储层计算，是神经形态与生物应用中强大而高效的框架，其中固定的随机储层驱动一个经过训练的输出读出。其性能关键取决于储层的初始化，因此用自适应、无监督的可塑性规则来丰富储层，为这一局限提供了自然的解决方案。然而，目前尚不清楚哪些规则有效、为何有效，以及如何在不进行穷尽且昂贵的搜索的情况下，为特定任务找到最合适的规则。在这里，我们学习如何在一个可塑的脉冲储层网络中玩Atari游戏Pong。我们系统地刻画了先前工作中通过元学习得到的一大类局部可塑性规则。随后我们表明，它们的性能是可预测且结构化的：高分规则的特征在于，编码球轨迹的神经元与背景之间存在强烈区分、权重动态稳定，以及读出在不同时间上保持一致对齐。这些机制性特征并非任务特异，并可迁移到一个延迟匹配识别任务。规则性能可以仅从规则参数估计。最后，将基于模拟的推断（SBI）以高分作为条件，使我们能够直接从规则空间中有希望的区域采样，从而发现性能超过先前分布中所发现规则的规则，并揭示稳定、高性能的配置。总之，这些结果在提供与经典储层计算相竞争的性能的同时，对是什么使一条可塑性规则对神经形态硬件和生物计算有用，给出了透明、可解释的说明。

papers.title: FMRP safeguards long mRNA expression by opposing repressive RNP states
papers.translated_title: FMRP通过对抗抑制性RNP状态来保障长mRNA的表达
papers.author: Ma, K.
papers.summary: Fragile X messenger ribonucleoprotein (FMRP) is widely viewed as a translational repressor, yet its loss paradoxically compromises expression of exceptionally long, dosage-sensitive neurodevelopmental mRNAs. First shown in Drosophila oocytes, this selective loss extends to mouse cortex and hippocampus, but its mechanism remains unknown. Here, we uncover a protective function for FMRP: shielding long mRNAs from repression by Me31B/DDX6, a conserved RNA helicase that organizes repressive RNP complexes. In Drosophila oocytes, FMRP loss redirects target mRNAs into Me31B-marked P-bodies. Transcriptome-wide binding maps reveal extensive FMRP-Me31B co-occupancy, preferentially concentrated on long coding sequences whose translation depends on FMRP. Strikingly, disrupting Me31B-dependent repression preferentially enhances translation of FMRP targets in FMRP-deficient oocytes. We identify Rin/G3BP, Caprin, and Lig/UBAP2L as FMRP-associated cofactors supporting expression of distinct targets. Together, our findings challenge the prevailing view of FMRP as a translational repressor, revealing instead a mechanism that safeguards vulnerable neurodevelopmental mRNAs from inappropriate cytoplasmic silencing.
papers.translated_summary: 脆性X信使核糖核蛋白（FMRP）被广泛视为一种翻译抑制因子，然而其缺失却矛盾地损害了异常长且对剂量敏感的神经发育mRNA的表达。这一选择性损失最初在果蝇卵母细胞中被发现，随后扩展至小鼠皮层和海马体，但其机制仍不清楚。在此，我们揭示了FMRP的一种保护功能：保护长mRNA免受Me31B/DDX6的抑制，后者是一种组织抑制性RNP复合物的保守RNA解旋酶。在果蝇卵母细胞中，FMRP缺失将靶mRNA重定向至Me31B标记的P小体。转录组范围的结合图谱揭示FMRP与Me31B广泛共占据，优先集中于翻译依赖于FMRP的长编码序列上。引人注目的是，破坏Me31B依赖性抑制优先增强了FMRP缺陷卵母细胞中FMRP靶标的翻译。我们鉴定出Rin/G3BP、Caprin和Lig/UBAP2L作为FMRP相关辅因子，支持不同靶标的表达。总之，我们的发现挑战了FMRP作为翻译抑制因子的主流观点，转而揭示了一种保护脆弱神经发育mRNA免于不当胞质沉默的机制。

papers.title: Integrated genomics and transcriptomics reveal molecular insights into extreme dietary adaptation in vampire bats
papers.translated_title: 综合基因组学与转录组学揭示吸血蝙蝠极端食性适应的分子机制
papers.author: Liu, S.
papers.summary: Vampire bats are the only tetrapods that feed exclusively on blood. To uncover the molecular changes associated with this extreme dietary specialization, we generated six new reference genomes, including genomes of all three vampire bat species, and integrated comparative analyses of gene sequence evolution (selection signatures, duplications, and losses) with transcriptomic data from six major organs to identify shifts in gene expression. Our integrative analyses reveal sequence or expression changes in 150 genes that provide insights into the molecular biology of sanguivory. Through comparative analyses and experiments, we show that the enlarged vampire bat stomach has increased connective tissue content, likely facilitating extreme expansion, is pH-neutral, and exhibits reduced mucus production, together providing molecular insights into its shift from a digestive to an absorptive organ for water, electrolytes, and vitamins. We further uncover pathway-level molecular changes associated with altered gastrointestinal motility; trypsin-dependent protein digestion; upregulated amino acid catabolism with key aspects diverging from other mammals; impaired dietary fat digestion counterbalanced by increased fatty acid synthesis; defective sugar metabolism and natural insulin deficiency; enhanced heme iron absorption; and adult splenic erythropoiesis. Together, these findings provide an integrated view of molecular changes associated with one of the most extreme dietary transitions among vertebrates.
papers.translated_summary: 吸血蝙蝠是唯一完全以血液为食的四足动物。为了揭示与这一极端食性特化相关的分子变化，我们生成了六个新的参考基因组，包括全部三种吸血蝙蝠的基因组，并将基因序列进化比较分析（选择特征、重复和丢失）与来自六个主要器官的转录组数据相结合，以识别基因表达的变化。我们的综合分析揭示了150个基因的序列或表达变化，为食血性的分子生物学提供了见解。通过比较分析和实验，我们发现增大的吸血蝙蝠胃具有增加的结缔组织含量，可能促进极端扩张，呈pH中性，并表现出减少的黏液产生，这些共同为其从消化器官转变为吸收水、电解质和维生素的器官提供了分子层面的见解。我们进一步揭示了与以下方面相关的通路水平分子变化：改变的胃肠动力；胰蛋白酶依赖性蛋白质消化；上调的氨基酸分解代谢，其关键方面与其他哺乳动物不同；受损的膳食脂肪消化由增加的脂肪酸合成所抵消；缺陷的糖代谢和天然胰岛素缺乏；增强的血红素铁吸收；以及成年脾脏红细胞生成。总之，这些发现为与脊椎动物中最极端的食性转变之一相关的分子变化提供了综合视角。

papers.title: Open-source benchmarking of dairy and dairy-free products
papers.translated_title: 乳制品及非乳制品的开源基准测试
papers.author: Koosis, A. O.
papers.summary: Dairy-free products offer opportunities to reduce the environmental impact of food. However, they must reproduce the diverse sensory and functional properties of conventional dairy, from foam stabilization in a latte to acid-gel structure in yogurt and melt--stretch behavior in mozzarella. Yet, large-scale, open-source sensory benchmarks across dairy product categories remain scarce. Here we show that the sensory gap between dairy and dairy-free products varies substantially across ten categories: barista milk, butter, cheddar, cream cheese, creamer, ice cream, fluid milk, mozzarella, sour cream, and Greek-style yogurt. We analyze the NECTAR Taste of the Industry 2026 dataset, which includes 1,437 respondents, 3,220 overall-liking ratings, and 79,027 recorded survey responses, including 35,762 product-linked responses. Leading dairy-free beverages, barista milk ($+0.17$), fluid milk ($+0.02$), and creamer ($-0.06$), closely approach their dairy benchmarks in overall liking on a seven-point scale. In contrast, mozzarella shows the largest deficit ($-1.46$), followed by Greek-style yogurt ($-0.68$) and butter ($-0.54$). All three deficits remain statistically significant after correction for multiple comparisons. Across categories, descriptive penalty analysis identifies off-flavor (1.85 points), stale or cardboard notes (1.81 points), and artificial or chemical notes (1.80 points) as the sensory attributes associated with the largest reductions in overall liking. Together, these results establish the first open sensory benchmark for dairy and dairy-free products, identify beverage categories that approach conventional dairy in overall liking, and reveal the sensory attributes and product categories with the greatest opportunities for future innovation.
papers.translated_summary: 无乳制品为减少食品的环境影响提供了机会。然而，它们必须复现传统乳制品的多样感官和功能特性，从拿铁中的泡沫稳定性到酸奶中的酸凝胶结构，再到马苏里拉奶酪的融化-拉伸行为。然而，跨乳制品类别的大规模、开源感官基准仍然稀缺。在此，我们表明乳制品与无乳制品之间的感官差距在十个类别中差异显著：咖啡师奶、黄油、切达奶酪、奶油奶酪、植脂奶精、冰淇淋、液态奶、马苏里拉奶酪、酸奶油和希腊式酸奶。我们分析了 NECTAR Taste of the Industry 2026 数据集，该数据集包括 1,437 名受访者、3,220 个总体喜好度评分和 79,027 条记录的调查回复，其中包括 35,762 条与产品关联的回复。领先的无乳制品饮料——咖啡师奶（+0.17）、液态奶（+0.02）和植脂奶精（-0.06）——在七分制总体喜好度上接近其乳制品基准。相比之下，马苏里拉奶酪的差距最大（-1.46），其次是希腊式酸奶（-0.68）和黄油（-0.54）。经多重比较校正后，这三项差距均具有统计学显著性。跨类别而言，描述性惩罚分析将异味（1.85 分）、陈旧或纸板味（1.81 分）以及人工或化学味（1.80 分）识别为与总体喜好度下降幅度最大的感官属性。总之，这些结果建立了首个乳制品与无乳制品的开源感官基准，识别出在总体喜好度上接近传统乳制品的饮料类别，并揭示了未来创新机会最大的感官属性和产品类别。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Protein-Ligand Binding Site Prediction from Protein Sequence and SMILES
papers.translated_title: 从蛋白质序列和SMILES进行零样本蛋白质-配体结合位点预测
papers.author: Pourmirzaei, M.
papers.summary: Accurate identification of protein-ligand binding sites is critical for mechanistic biology and drug discovery, yet predictive performance varies substantially across ligand families and data-availability regimes. We present a systematic ligand-aware benchmark and evaluation framework for residue-level binding-site prediction across three settings: overrepresented ligands with abundant examples, underrepresented ligands with limited examples, and zero-shot ligands unseen during training. Using a BioLiP2-derived dataset with ligand-specific sequence clustering, we evaluate a progressive three-stage sequence-based modeling suite designed to study these regimes. Stage 1 trains ligand-specific predictors using a pretrained protein language model (PLM). Stage 2 introduces ligand conditioning through learned embeddings, enabling a single multi-ligand model. Stage 3 replaces these embeddings with representations from a pretrained chemical language model (CLM) operating on SMILES, enabling prediction for previously unseen ligands. In the original three-stage comparison, Stage 2 achieved a higher ligand-macro F1 than Stage 1 on the overrepresented test set (0.5832 versus 0.4769), although the comparison simultaneously changes predictor architecture, ligand conditioning, and the training regime. Stage 2 also outperformed several sequence- and structure-based baselines. Stage 3 achieves a pooled residue-level F1 of 0.3109 and a ligand-macro F1 of 0.2338 on previously unseen ligands, while remaining competitive on represented ligands. Control experiments using constant, mismatched, and scrambled SMILES inputs reduce performance across all three test regimes, providing evidence that the model uses information associated with the supplied ligand input rather than relying solely on generic protein binding-site propensity. Ablations across five PLM scales and multiple CLMs further show that increasing PLM scale generally improves performance, although the trend is not strictly monotonic, whereas CLM scaling produces smaller and less consistent gains. Overall, this study provides a systematic benchmark for quantifying the effect of ligand data availability on residue-level binding-site prediction and for evaluating generalization to previously unseen ligands.
papers.translated_summary: 准确识别蛋白质-配体结合位点对于机制生物学和药物发现至关重要，但预测性能在不同配体家族和数据可用性条件下存在显著差异。我们提出了一个系统的配体感知基准和评估框架，用于在三种设置下进行残基级结合位点预测：具有丰富样本的过代表配体、具有有限样本的低代表配体，以及训练期间未见过的零样本配体。使用源自BioLiP2并具有配体特异性序列聚类的数据集，我们评估了一个渐进式三阶段基于序列的建模套件，旨在研究这些情形。阶段1使用预训练蛋白质语言模型（PLM）训练配体特异性预测器。阶段2通过学习到的嵌入引入配体条件化，从而能够构建单一多配体模型。阶段3用基于SMILES运行的预训练化学语言模型（CLM）的表示替换这些嵌入，从而能够对先前未见过的配体进行预测。在原始的三阶段比较中，阶段2在过代表测试集上取得了高于阶段1的配体宏F1（0.5832对0.4769），尽管该比较同时改变了预测器架构、配体条件化和训练机制。阶段2也优于若干基于序列和基于结构的基线。阶段3在先前未见过的配体上取得了0.3109的汇总残基级F1和0.2338的配体宏F1，同时在已代表配体上保持竞争力。使用恒定、错配和打乱的SMILES输入进行的对照实验降低了所有三种测试情形下的性能，提供了证据表明模型使用了与所提供配体输入相关的信息，而不是仅依赖一般性的蛋白质结合位点倾向。跨五个PLM规模和多个CLM的消融进一步表明，增加PLM规模通常会提高性能，尽管该趋势并非严格单调，而CLM扩展产生的增益较小且较不一致。总体而言，本研究提供了一个系统基准，用于量化配体数据可用性对残基级结合位点预测的影响，并评估对先前未见配体的泛化能力。

papers.title: CryoSHIELDs: tunable amphipathic peptide additives for cryo-EM
papers.translated_title: CryoSHIELDs：用于冷冻电镜的可调两亲性肽添加剂
papers.author: Azumaya, C. M.
papers.summary: While cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has transformed structural biology, sample preparation remains a major determinant of success. Specifically, the air-water interface (AWI) can damage complexes, impose preferred orientation, and reduce particle density. Here, we introduce cryoSHIELDs, a library of peptide additives designed to modulate the AWI and improve cryo-EM grid preparation. Across 24 diverse protein systems, cryoSHIELDs improved particle distribution, angular sampling, complex integrity, and, in selected cases, map quality and resolution. CryoSHIELDs enabled structure determination of the OSMR{beta}-Vixarelimab complex, the multi-subunit CCAN kinetochore complex without chemical cross-linking, and membrane proteins including ABCC6 and the -opioid receptor-Gi complex, the latter resolved at 2.3 A using tenfold lower protein concentration without compromising map quality. CryoSHIELDs provide a simple, tunable, and broadly applicable platform for more reliable cryo-EM in discovery biology and structure-based drug development.
papers.translated_summary: 尽管冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）已经改变了结构生物学，但样品制备仍然是决定成功的主要因素。具体而言，空气-水界面（AWI）可能损伤复合物、造成优势取向并降低颗粒密度。在此，我们介绍了cryoSHIELDs，这是一个旨在调控AWI并改进冷冻电镜载网制备的肽添加剂文库。在24种不同的蛋白质体系中，cryoSHIELDs改善了颗粒分布、角度采样、复合物完整性，并在部分案例中提升了密度图质量和分辨率。cryoSHIELDs使得以下结构测定成为可能：OSMR{beta}-Vixarelimab复合物、未经化学交联的多亚基CCAN动粒复合物，以及包括ABCC6和μ-阿片受体-Gi复合物在内的膜蛋白，后者在蛋白质浓度降低十倍且不损害密度图质量的情况下以2.3 Å分辨率解析。cryoSHIELDs为发现生物学和基于结构的药物开发中更可靠的冷冻电镜提供了一个简单、可调且广泛适用的平台。

papers.title: The methionine cycle sustains the mesenchymal phenotype of tumor cells and drives PDA progression
papers.translated_title: 甲硫氨酸循环维持肿瘤细胞的间充质表型并驱动PDA进展
papers.author: Vasseur, S.
papers.summary: Mesenchymal traits are associated with poor prognosis in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (PDA), but direct targeting of mesenchymal tumor cells remains a challenge. Metabolic profiling of tumor cells isolated from murine PDA and liver metastases (LM) revealed that LM rely more on the methionine cycle than does primary PDA. This metabolic shift was specifically associated with increased activation of the methionine cycle in mesenchymal tumor cells compared to differentiated tumor cells. We show that the targeting of the key enzyme of the methionine cycle S-adenosylhomocysteine hydrolase (SAHH) in mesenchymal cells lowers the levels of homocysteine (Hcy) and glutathione, resulting in reduced antioxidant capacity, deregulated intracellular calcium homeostasis, and ultimately loss of mesenchymal markers. Together, these events decrease cell proliferation and invasion, blunting the tumorigenic and metastatic potential of SAHH-deficient cells, eventually impeding tumor growth and progression of the metastatic disease. Clinically, the high expression of SAHH in patients with mesenchymal PDA is correlated with poor survival, positioning SAHH as a potential therapeutic target to impede the pro-metastatic, mesenchymal phenotype of PDA.
papers.translated_summary: 间充质特征与胰腺导管腺癌（PDA）的不良预后相关，但直接靶向间充质肿瘤细胞仍是一项挑战。对从小鼠PDA和肝转移灶（LM）中分离的肿瘤细胞进行代谢谱分析显示，LM比原发PDA更依赖甲硫氨酸循环。这种代谢转变特异性地与间充质肿瘤细胞中甲硫氨酸循环活化增加相关，而非分化型肿瘤细胞。我们证明，靶向间充质细胞中甲硫氨酸循环的关键酶S-腺苷同型半胱氨酸水解酶（SAHH）可降低同型半胱氨酸（Hcy）和谷胱甘肽的水平，导致抗氧化能力下降、细胞内钙稳态失调，最终丧失间充质标志物。综合来看，这些事件降低了细胞增殖和侵袭能力，削弱了SAHH缺陷细胞的致瘤和转移潜能，最终阻碍肿瘤生长和转移性疾病的进展。在临床上，间充质型PDA患者中SAHH的高表达与不良生存相关，使SAHH成为阻碍PDA促转移间充质表型的潜在治疗靶点。

papers.title: Extending the least-cost theory of stomatal regulation to include soil moisture stress
papers.translated_title: 将气孔调节的最小成本理论扩展至包含土壤水分胁迫
papers.author: Sandoval, D.
papers.summary: Terrestrial biosphere models commonly use empirical scaling factors to represent soil moisture constraints on carbon and water fluxes, but these lack mechanistic grounding and produce inconsistent estimates of soil moisture limitations on primary production and transpiration across models. Here we extended the least-cost hypothesis for optimal stomatal conductance to account for soil moisture limitations by allowing soil water availability to modulate the carbon cost of water transport, drawing on the observed temperature dependence of stem respiration, and derived a simple empirical approximation to the theory using global {delta}13C and eddy covariance data. The empirical analysis shows moderated thermal acclimation of stem respiration and a weak increase in water transport costs with aridity, supporting the interpretation that the decline in light-use efficiency (LUE) under arid conditions is primarily attributable to non-stomatal limitations. Validation against an independent global dataset of sapflow-derived canopy conductance and transpiration shows that the revised scheme significantly improves the predictive power of the least-cost hypothesis, offering a more mechanistically coherent alternative to existing soil moisture parameterisations.
papers.translated_summary: 陆地生物圈模型通常使用经验缩放因子来表示土壤水分对碳通量和水通量的限制，但这些因子缺乏机制基础，并且在不同模型之间对土壤水分限制初级生产量和蒸腾作用的估计不一致。在此，我们扩展了最优气孔导度的最小成本假说，通过允许土壤水可用性调节水分运输的碳成本来考虑土壤水分限制，借鉴了观测到的茎呼吸温度依赖性，并利用全球δ13C和涡度相关数据推导出该理论的一个简单经验近似。经验分析显示茎呼吸的热驯化有所缓和，水分运输成本随干旱度 weakly 增加，支持了干旱条件下光利用效率（LUE）下降主要归因于非气孔限制的解释。针对一个独立的全球数据集（由液流推导的冠层导度和蒸腾作用）进行验证表明，修订后的方案显著提高了最小成本假说的预测能力，为现有的土壤水分参数化方案提供了一种更具机制一致性的替代方案。

papers.title: Hierarchical organization in sparse gene regulatory networks shapes structural coherence and emergent regulatory coordination
papers.translated_title: 稀疏基因调控网络中的层次化组织塑造结构连贯性与涌现调控协调
papers.author: Harlapur, P.
papers.summary: A fundamental challenge in systems biology is understanding how regulatory coordination is maintained within extremely sparse gene regulatory networks (GRNs). While traditional unsigned network metrics can quantify the overall magnitude of influence a specific node or edge exerts over the network, they cannot predict the functional direction and consistency of these regulatory changes. To address this gap, we introduce the coherence matrix. This topology-based framework for signed, directed GRNs computes a strictly bounded, interpretable measure of directional regulatory coordination between gene pairs. Using synthetic network ensembles, we demonstrate that architectures with low intrinsic structural coherence suffer severe density-driven scaling penalties. Such structures cannot scale without requiring biologically unrealistic edge densities. Applying this framework to six whole-organism GRNs reveals how biological topologies overcome these limitations. Whole-organism GRNs exhibit lower overall coherence and more fragmented structures than expected, avoiding rigid global co-regulation to maximize regulatory degrees of freedom. Furthermore, these systems resolve the scaling penalties of complex, low-coherence architectures by restricting dense regulatory crosstalk to a compact intermediate core. Modeling synthetic hierarchical networks confirms that this architecture, a compact core within a globally feed-forward scaffold, neutralizes scaling penalties by minimizing nodes requiring dense connectivity. This allows GRNs to efficiently route decisions despite extreme sparsity. Finally, validation with transcriptomic data confirms that coherence matrix accurately predicts empirical co-regulation directionality. By moving beyond unsigned connectivity, the structural coherence framework provides a quantitative tool to map how the intrinsic behavior of localized interactions scales into macroscopic, system-wide coordination.
papers.translated_summary: 系统生物学的一个根本挑战在于理解极稀疏基因调控网络（GRNs）中调控协调是如何维持的。传统的无符号网络指标可以量化特定节点或边对网络的整体影响幅度，但无法预测这些调控变化的功能方向和一致性。为弥补这一空白，我们引入相干矩阵。这一基于拓扑的框架适用于有符号、有向的GRN，可计算基因对之间方向性调控协调的严格有界、可解释度量。利用合成网络集合，我们证明内在结构相干性低的架构会遭受严重的密度驱动缩放惩罚。此类结构若不具备生物学上不现实的边密度便无法扩展。将该框架应用于六个全生物体GRN，揭示了生物拓扑如何克服这些限制。全生物体GRN表现出比预期更低的整体相干性和更碎片化的结构，避免刚性的全局共调控以最大化调控自由度。此外，这些系统通过将密集调控串扰限制在紧凑的中间核心，解决了复杂低相干架构的缩放惩罚。对合成层级网络的建模证实，这种架构——全局前馈支架内的紧凑核心——通过最小化需要密集连接的节点来中和缩放惩罚。这使得GRN尽管极度稀疏，仍能高效地路由决策。最后，利用转录组数据进行的验证证实，相干矩阵能准确预测经验共调控的方向性。通过超越无符号连通性，结构相干性框架提供了一种定量工具，用以映射局部相互作用的内在行为如何缩放为宏观的、系统范围的协调。

papers.title: Diagnostic Value in Discarded Reads: Re-evaluating Multi-Mapping cfDNA Fragmentomics and GC Bias in Early-Stage Cancer.
papers.translated_title: 废弃读段中的诊断价值：重新评估早期癌症中多比对cfDNA片段组学与GC偏倚
papers.author: UPPALURI, K. R.
papers.summary: Background. Low-coverage plasma cell-free DNA (cfDNA) sequencing is an inexpensive substrate for cancer detection. Standard pipelines discard fragments with low mapping quality, which originate mostly from repetitive DNA, although pericentromeric satellite repeats are frequently hypomethylated in cancer. We asked whether the fraction of multi-mapping cfDNA fragments differs between early-stage cancer and matched healthy controls, and how it compares with conventional fragmentomic features under strict control of technical factors. Methods. We analysed public plasma cfDNA whole-genome sequencing from 25 patients with stage I to III breast cancer and 25 healthy controls matched 1:1 for age, sex, smoking and alcohol use, each pair processed in the same library and sequencing batch, and from 8 early-stage hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) cases with 8 matched controls. For every sample we computed the fraction of autosomal fragments with MAPQ < 30 and the share of these fragments located in centromeric and heterochromatic cytobands, and related them to stage, grade and copy-number deviation as proxies of tumour burden. Classifiers were evaluated by leave-one-pair-out cross-validation in breast cancer and, trained on breast cancer only, applied unchanged to HCC. Robustness to GC content and sequencing depth was tested by within-fold residualisation and by fragment-level GC weighting. Conventional fragmentomic features (fragment length, end motifs, copy number, DELFI-like profiles and window features at transcription start sites) were evaluated under four GC-handling analyses. Results. The multi-mapping fraction was higher in breast cancer than in matched controls (median 5.38 % vs 5.19 %; higher in 19/25 pairs; paired p = 0.0006; cross-validated AUC 0.81, 95 % CI 0.67 - 0.94), in stage I (9/10 pairs), stage II (7/10) and stage III (3/5) disease and in every sequencing batch. The excess was concentrated in centromeric and heterochromatic bands, whose share of multi-mapping fragments rose from 22.0 % to 23.4 % (19/25 pairs; p = 0.004). Both signals persisted after within-fold adjustment for GC content and/or depth (AUC 0.64 - 0.76 for the multi-mapping fraction, 0.71 - 0.76 for the heterochromatic share) and under fragment-level GC weighting (18/25 pairs; p = 0.003). The multi-mapping difference was largest in stage I and decreased with stage (Spearman {rho} = -0.42, p = 0.04), and neither feature was associated with grade or copy-number deviation. In public tissue methylomes, satellites were hypomethylated in breast tumours to a similar extent as other late-replicating DNA, but the bin-level association between tumour hypomethylation and the cfDNA excess was weak and was explained by GC content. In HCC, the pre-specified endpoint, the breast-trained multi-mapping model, was not met (AUC 0.73; 5/8 pairs; sign test p = 0.36). In an exploratory analysis that was not pre-specified, the heterochromatic share was higher in 7/8 HCC pairs (p = 0.016; locked AUC 0.86, 95 % CI 0.62 - 1.00); across all 33 pairs, including the discovery pairs, it was higher in the cancer case in 26 (post hoc sign test p = 0.0007). In contrast, conventional fragmentomic features reached AUC 0.71 (breast) and 0.77 (HCC) only without fragment-level GC control; they tracked the per-sample coverage GC dependence and fell to chance under each of three GC-controlled analyses, including one that preserves promoter-specific signal. Conclusions. Multi-mapping cfDNA fragments, which are routinely discarded, differed between early-stage breast cancer and batch-matched controls, largely independently of GC content and sequencing depth, with an excess in centromeric and heterochromatic DNA. The signal did not scale with stage, its biological origin is unproven, and a read-quality contribution cannot be excluded from fragment files. It is a candidate marker that requires confirmation in larger cohorts with raw reads and tumour-fraction estimates.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。低覆盖度的血浆游离DNA（cfDNA）测序是一种廉价的癌症检测底物。标准流程会丢弃比对质量低的片段，这些片段主要来源于重复DNA，尽管在癌症中近着丝粒卫星重复序列常呈低甲基化。我们探究了多比对cfDNA片段的比例在早期癌症与匹配的健康对照之间是否存在差异，以及在严格控制技术因素的条件下其与常规片段组学特征的比较情况。方法。我们分析了来自25例I至III期乳腺癌患者和25例健康对照的公开血浆cfDNA全基因组测序数据，对照按年龄、性别、吸烟和饮酒情况1：1匹配，每对样本在同一文库和测序批次中处理；另分析了8例早期肝细胞癌（HCC）病例及8例匹配对照。对每个样本，我们计算了MAPQ < 30的常染色体片段比例以及这些片段位于着丝粒和异染色质细胞带中的份额，并将其与分期、分级和拷贝数偏差（作为肿瘤负荷的替代指标）相关联。分类器在乳腺癌中通过留一对交叉验证进行评估，并仅在乳腺癌上训练后原样应用于HCC。通过折内残差化和片段级GC加权检验了对GC含量和测序深度的稳健性。常规片段组学特征（片段长度、末端基序、拷贝数、类DELFI图谱和转录起始位点窗口特征）在四种GC处理分析下进行评估。结果。多比对片段比例在乳腺癌中高于匹配对照（中位数5.38 % vs 5.19 %；19/25对中更高；配对p = 0.0006；交叉验证AUC 0.81，95 % CI 0.67 - 0.94），在I期（9/10对）、II期（7/10）和III期（3/5）疾病中以及每个测序批次中均如此。该超额集中于着丝粒和异染色质带，其多比对片段份额从22.0 %升至23.4 %（19/25对；p = 0.004）。两种信号在折内校正GC含量和/或深度后持续存在（多比对片段AUC 0.64 - 0.76，异染色质份额AUC 0.71 - 0.76），在片段级GC加权下亦持续存在（18/25对；p = 0.003）。多比对差异在I期最大并随分期降低（Spearman {rho} = -0.42，p = 0.04），两种特征均与分级或拷贝数偏差无关。在公开组织甲基化组中，卫星序列在乳腺肿瘤中的低甲基化程度与其他晚复制DNA相似，但肿瘤低甲基化与cfDNA超额之间的区间级关联较弱，且可由GC含量解释。在HCC中，预设终点、乳腺癌训练的多比对模型未达到（AUC 0.73；5/8对；符号检验p = 0.36）。在一项未预设的探索性分析中，异染色质份额在7/8的HCC对中更高（p = 0.016；锁定AUC 0.86，95 % CI 0.62 - 1.00）；在包括发现对在内的全部33对中，癌症病例中有26对更高（事后符号检验p = 0.0007）。相比之下，常规片段组学特征仅在无片段级GC控制时达到AUC 0.71（乳腺癌）和0.77（HCC）；它们跟随每样本覆盖度的GC依赖性，并在三种GC控制分析（包括一种保留启动子特异性信号的分析）中的每一种下均降至随机水平。结论。常规被丢弃的多比对cfDNA片段在早期乳腺癌与批次匹配对照之间存在差异，很大程度上独立于GC含量和测序深度，且在着丝粒和异染色质DNA中呈超额。该信号不随分期缩放，其生物学来源尚未证实，且不能从片段文件中排除读段质量的贡献。它是一个候选标志物，需要在具有原始读段和肿瘤分数估计的更大队列中加以确认。

papers.title: ShortKit-ML: an open toolkit for measuring shortcut potential in medical imaging embeddings
papers.translated_title: ShortKit-ML：一个用于测量医学影像嵌入中捷径潜力的开放工具包
papers.author: Cajas, S.
papers.summary: Background and Objective: A classifier trained on frozen embeddings can take a shortcut through a sensitive attribute only if the embedding carries information about it beyond what the task label explains: its shortcut potential. We asked whether this can be measured on the embedding alone with a known false positive rate, and whether it predicts how strongly a classifier trained on confounded data relies on the attribute. Methods: ShortKit-ML tests whether an embedding E and a sensitive attribute A are dependent given a task label Y. The primary test is a condi- tional probe: a logistic regression that predicts A from E and Y, scored by out-of-fold AUROC and calibrated by permuting A within levels of Y, be- tween patients. Five secondary detectors share this null. We audited sex, age and race for seven frozen encoders on CheXpert and four on MIMIC-CXR, and trained heads on confounded CheXpert splits. Results: Under the null the probe rejected in 0.02 of synthetic data sets. With A and Y strongly correlated, an unconditional probe rejected in 0.95 and the conditional probe in 0.03. No detector found signals that leave group means unchanged, unlike probes on squared or product features under the same null. The probe found attribute information in 21 of 21 CheXpert and 12 of 12 MIMIC-CXR cells. Across 42 CheXpert cells the probe score correlated with the true positive rate gap of a confounded head (Spearman 0.60, 95% CI 0.31 to 0.80 resampling encoders), 0.74 within sex and not significantly within age. Three embedding-level mitigations changed the gap by at most 0.01 relative to their controls. Refitting the head on a group-balanced subset closed it. A planted image marker was found in all 10 seeds. Conclusions: One calibrated linear test measures shortcut potential on a frozen embedding, and on CheXpert its score correlated with how strongly a confounded logistic head relied on the attribute, clearly for sex. It does not show that a given head uses the attribute, and lowering the score did not remove reliance, so the head itself must be tested as well. Code is at https://github.com/criticaldata/ShortKit-ML.
papers.translated_summary: 背景与目标：在冻结嵌入上训练的分类器，只有当嵌入携带了超出任务标签所能解释的敏感属性信息时，才能通过该敏感属性走捷径：这就是其捷径潜力。我们探究了能否仅凭嵌入本身、以已知的假阳性率来测量这一潜力，以及它是否能预测在混杂数据上训练的分类器对该属性的依赖程度。方法：ShortKit-ML 检验嵌入 E 与敏感属性 A 在给定任务标签 Y 的条件下是否相关。主要检验是条件探针：一个从 E 和 Y 预测 A 的逻辑回归，以折外 AUROC 评分，并通过在患者之间于 Y 的各水平内置换 A 进行校准。五个次级检测器共享这一零假设。我们在 CheXpert 的七个冻结编码器和 MIMIC-CXR 的四个冻结编码器上审计了性别、年龄和种族，并在混杂的 CheXpert 划分上训练了头部。结果：在零假设下，探针在 0.02 的合成数据集中拒绝。当 A 与 Y 强相关时，无条件探针在 0.95 的情况下拒绝，而条件探针在 0.03 的情况下拒绝。没有检测器发现使组均值保持不变信号，这与在同一零假设下对平方或乘积特征的探针不同。探针在 21 个 CheXpert 单元中的 21 个和 12 个 MIMIC-CXR 单元中的 12 个中发现了属性信息。在 42 个 CheXpert 单元中，探针得分与混杂头部的真阳性率差距相关（Spearman 0.60，95% CI 0.31 至 0.80，重采样编码器），在性别内为 0.74，在年龄内不显著。三种嵌入层面的缓解措施相对于其对照最多将差距改变 0.01。在组平衡子集上重新拟合头部消除了该差距。在所有 10 个种子中都发现了植入的图像标记。结论：一个校准的线性检验可在冻结嵌入上测量捷径潜力，并且在 CheXpert 上其得分与混杂逻辑头部对该属性的依赖程度相关，对性别尤为明显。它并不表明某个给定头部使用了该属性，而且降低得分并未消除依赖，因此头部本身也必须被检验。代码见 https://github.com/criticaldata/ShortKit-ML。

papers.title: Dense Breast Tissue Segmentation under Limited Annotation: Comparing CNNs, Transformers, Self-Supervision, and Prompting
papers.translated_title: 有限标注下的致密乳腺组织分割：比较CNN、Transformer、自监督与提示方法
papers.author: Qu, B.
papers.summary: Dense breast tissue reduces the sensitivity of mammographic screening and is an important risk factor for breast cancer, making accurate dense-tissue segmentation particularly important when expert pixel-level annotations are limited. We empirically study dense breast tissue segmentation under limited pixel-level supervision using a small expert-annotated dataset (596 images) together with an in-domain unlabeled mammography dataset (20{,}000 images). We compare classical pixel-level segmentation methods, CNN and U-Net encoder--decoder models, transformer-based models, self-supervised pre-training, fine-tuning strategies, loss functions, and prompt-based MedSAM variants under a unified evaluation protocol. CNN-based models achieve the best standalone segmentation performance while providing the most favorable balance between accuracy and computational cost. In contrast, the adaptive fuzzy c-means + SVM baseline and transformer-based models perform worse in this low-label setting. Our analysis of prompt-based MedSAM further shows that SAM-style models are highly sensitive to prompt quality. Box and breast-region prompts lead to poor performance, whereas CNN-generated dense prompts substantially improve MedSAM performance. However, even with mask-decoder fine-tuning, CNN-prompted MedSAM does not outperform the best standalone CNN model, suggesting that current SAM-style models require stronger prompts or adaptation beyond the mask decoder for diffuse breast-density segmentation. Additionally, a density-calibrated hybrid loss primarily improves percent-density calibration by reducing the test MAE from 14.8 to 11.8 percentage points. Our computational cost analysis indicates that many generic self-supervised learning and parameter-efficient adaptation strategies provide limited practical benefit relative to their additional cost. These findings offer practical guidance for developing reproducible dense breast tissue segmentation models in mammography studies with limited labeled data.
papers.translated_summary: 致密乳腺组织会降低乳腺X线摄影筛查的敏感性，并且是乳腺癌的重要风险因素，因此在专家像素级标注有限的情况下，准确的致密组织分割尤为重要。我们利用一个小的专家标注数据集（596张图像）以及一个域内未标注乳腺X线摄影数据集（20,000张图像），在有限的像素级监督下对致密乳腺组织分割进行实证研究。我们在统一的评估协议下比较了经典像素级分割方法、CNN和U-Net编码器--解码器模型、基于Transformer的模型、自监督预训练、微调策略、损失函数以及基于提示的MedSAM变体。基于CNN的模型取得了最佳的独立分割性能，同时在准确性与计算成本之间提供了最有利的平衡。相比之下，自适应模糊c均值+SVM基线以及基于Transformer的模型在这种低标注设置下表现较差。我们对基于提示的MedSAM的分析进一步表明，SAM风格的模型对提示质量高度敏感。框提示和乳腺区域提示导致性能较差，而CNN生成的致密提示则显著提升了MedSAM的性能。然而，即使经过掩码解码器微调，CNN提示的MedSAM仍未超越最佳的独立CNN模型，这表明当前的SAM风格模型在弥漫性乳腺密度分割中需要更强的提示或超越掩码解码器的适配。此外，一种密度校准的混合损失主要通过将测试MAE从14.8个百分点降低到11.8个百分点来改善百分比密度校准。我们的计算成本分析表明，许多通用的自监督学习和参数高效适配策略相对于其额外成本而言提供的实际收益有限。这些发现为在标注数据有限的乳腺X线摄影研究中开发可复现的致密乳腺组织分割模型提供了实用指导。
